subject.title: feat: version field in health response + POST /admin/update endpoint

question: Should OpenClaw expose update execution to gateway-authenticated HTTP callers, and if so should it be a new /admin/update endpoint or an intentional Admin HTTP RPC wrapper around update.run?
rationale: The request expands host package-update and restart authority from existing CLI/WebSocket/control-plane paths to a network HTTP surface, so automation cannot safely choose the auth, audit, rate-limit, and failure-mode contract.

options.title: Split and design first
options.body: Keep version metadata in the narrower tracker and require maintainer-owned security/API design before exposing update execution over HTTP.

options.title: Expose through Admin HTTP RPC
options.body: Add update.run or a narrow wrapper to the default-off Admin HTTP RPC plugin with explicit trusted-ingress, auth, audit, rate-limit, and handoff proof requirements.

options.title: Reject HTTP update execution
options.body: Keep update execution limited to existing CLI/WebSocket/control-plane surfaces and document that fleet tools should use those or an external orchestrator.

recommendation.title: Split and design first
recommendation.body: Keep version metadata in the narrower tracker and require maintainer-owned security/API design before exposing update execution over HTTP.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest shared history across Admin HTTP RPC, gateway update flow, and adjacent version resolution.
